name: Fansubs.ru (Russian)
description: Russian fansub subtitles from fansubs.ru (Kage Project). Searches the archive by title and resolves the matching release for the requested episode.

resolverBase.description: Base URL of the fansubs.ru unpacker resolver (see resolver/README.md). It converts the site's .rar/.7z release archives into direct subtitle file URLs. Set to 'direct' to return raw fansubs.ru archive URLs instead.

preferredFormat.description: Preferred subtitle format. 'any' returns every matching release.

searchRetries.description: How many times to retry the search endpoint. fansubs.ru search is intermittently unreliable and often returns zero results on the first attempt.

useArchiveFallback.description: When search returns nothing, fall back to browsing the A-Z archive index and matching titles locally. Slower but far more reliable.

verifyAniDbId.description: Verify candidates against the AniDB id linked on the anime page when the query provides one. Raises match accuracy at the cost of one extra request per candidate.
